authority.source: OWNER brief 'NWF Partnership Engine — R8: Global Research Execution' (2026-10-20)
authority.objectiveVerbatim: The OWNER authorises a local, synthetic-only R8 implementation, using the decisions below. No real research or production activation is authorised.
restrictionsVerbatim: No pushes, real network acquisition, production/staging migrations, deployments, operational keys, real canonical identity issuance, Qualification activation or outreach.
Do not modify the Operator repository or existing French release records.

migrationAppliedTo: disposable tmpfs PostgreSQL 16 test databases only
openForOwner: Ratify or reject ADR 0025 and migration 0017.
Decide OWNER review-key custody and provision one ACTIVE operational key (ADR 0023 s15); without it no real subject can be confirmed or admitted.
Decide whether and when to apply migration 0017 to nwf_pe, with a measured lock window and a before/after root_key and corpus-digest proof.
Authorise (or not) a subject research CLI and an OWNER-path admission command.
Decide whether to amend ADR 0023 s11a so a recorded protection re-evaluation can clear UNCERTAIN-registered subjects (ADR 0025 s6); until then they stay blocked.
